Canvas

A skill that brings scenarios, annotations, a zoomable screen board, and developer inspection into one review experience.

A prototype is easy to share and hard to review. A link does not tell someone which clicks matter, which rules are hidden, or how to reach a particular state. A linear walkthrough only explains one path. I built Canvas to make the cases, the board, and the developer view part of the prototype itself.

Scenarios put a reviewer into a useful case with one click. Modes describe states such as role, permission, or locale, with an explicit way in and out. Numbered pins explain rules beside the UI. Deep links open the same case for the next reviewer. The board uses static snapshots instead of running every screen at once, and Inspect turns an element into a build prompt.
